assumptions: Maya, every session, every action, and every minute are invented for this rehearsal.
No application, LLM, Jev service, teacher, or pupil was contacted or observed.
The baseline reuses a school lesson bank and paper fraction strips for the same objective and quality bar.
The assumed prototype supplies the complete review and approved follow-up paths described in the protocol.
The day-1 setup includes eight fictional minutes of researcher help. Later sessions assume no researcher help.
Each total includes setup, preparation, review, correction, sharing, and follow-up. Classroom teaching duration is outside both totals.
Day-12 review takes longer because Maya inspects every feedback branch for a new equivalence example.
Permission, procurement, real classroom use, and learning outcomes remain unknown.

sessions.event: In this invented first session, Maya asks for a worked example. Setup includes eight minutes of help. She corrects an unclear instruction before approval.
sessions.decision: Use the imagined approved lesson, but reserve judgment. The first product task needs more total work than the familiar lesson bank.

sessions.event: The second imagined task is familiar. Maya corrects ambiguous feedback before approval. A synthetic response selects 2/3 for 1/2. She inspects the response and selects approved equal-parts practice.
sessions.decision: Try another lesson. Total invented effort is lower than the comparable baseline, with no unresolved content error.

sessions.event: In this scripted week-two return, Maya prepares a new equivalent-fractions example without encouragement. She corrects one instruction and inspects every answer path.
sessions.decision: Continue for this imagined lesson. Familiar setup and structured examples reduce the invented preparation cost.

sessions.event: A new imagined equivalence example requires longer inspection of feedback branches. Maya corrects one explanation before approval. Review nearly removes the preparation benefit.
sessions.decision: Use this imagined lesson after correction. Keep the school lesson bank available because the product advantage is small on this task.

stated_preference: In this role-play, I prefer a worked example and a visible review path. I will compare the whole task before I change my normal method.
week_two_reason: The scripted day-4 task takes less total effort without unresolved errors, so Maya elects to return on day 8. This authored choice does not predict real teacher return.
next_real_test: Observe a consenting target teacher prepare comparable lessons with existing materials and the actual product. Include first-use help, all feedback review, corrections, and a later unprompted use decision.
